films.desc_en: A premium spa commercial following a woman's relaxing journey in a luxurious wellness center inspired by Macedonian nature.
films.music: Calm, relaxing ambient spa music with soft chimes, 60 bpm
vo_mk: Препуштете се на врвно спа искуство.

shots.kf: A 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a white linen robe, stands on a wooden terrace overlooking the stunning Canyon Matka. The water is deep green, surrounded by towering rocky cliffs. Soft morning sunlight illuminates her face. Shot with a 50mm lens, cinematic composition, photorealistic, serene atmosphere.
shots.motion: The woman breathes in deeply as her hair blows gently in the wind. The camera slowly pushes in towards her face.

shots.kf: The same 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a white linen robe, walks slowly down a luxurious spa corridor. Warm ambient light glows from wall sconces, illuminating the smooth stone walls and wooden floor. Photorealistic, wide tracking shot, elegant and calm.
shots.motion: The woman walks forward gracefully in slow motion. The camera slowly tracks backward to reveal more of the elegant hallway.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair relaxes in a bubbling hydrotherapy tub, visible only from the shoulders up. Gentle steam rises around her against a backdrop of dark slate tiles and flickering candles. Photorealistic, intimate close-up, 85mm lens, warm and relaxing mood.
shots.motion: Gentle bubbles ripple across the surface of the water as steam rises slowly. The camera slowly pans right.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing her white linen robe, sits by a large window. Her skin is glowing and radiant. Soft natural light wraps around her features, creating a deeply peaceful expression. Photorealistic, medium portrait, shallow depth of field.
shots.motion: The woman smiles softly and closes her eyes in complete relaxation. The camera slowly dollies in for an intimate feel.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old woman with long wavy brown hair, in a white linen robe, holds a ceramic cup of herbal tea on a sunny balcony. Lush green trees and a clear blue sky form the background. Photorealistic, bright and airy color palette, premium lifestyle photography.
shots.motion: Steam rises from the ceramic cup as she brings it slightly closer to her chest. The camera tilts up slowly.

films.line_en: Be the best version of yourself.
films.desc_en: A stylish commercial showcasing a modern barbershop experience for men in a vintage cobblestone setting.
films.music: Cool, rhythmic jazz hop with a confident bassline, 90 bpm

shots.kf: A 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt stands in front of a vintage barbershop in the Old Bazaar of Skopje. The cobblestone street and old wooden doors create a timeless, premium atmosphere. Cinematic lighting, photorealistic, wide shot.
shots.motion: The man looks thoughtfully at the storefront, standing completely still. The camera slowly pushes in towards the wooden doors.

shots.kf: The same 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt sits in a classic leather barber chair. He gazes into a large, ornate mirror. Warm amber bulbs illuminate the premium interior. Photorealistic, over-the-shoulder shot, 50mm lens, moody tones.
shots.motion: The man turns his head slightly to examine his profile in the mirror. The camera slowly pans to the left.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old man with short dark hair and a black button-down shirt relaxes with a steaming hot towel wrapped over his face. Warm, moody lighting highlights the steam rising in the premium barbershop interior. Photorealistic, medium close-up, rich shadows and gold highlights.
shots.motion: Thick steam rises slowly from the hot towel as the man breathes steadily. The camera slowly dollies forward.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt sits proudly in the chair, looking sharp and refreshed. A vintage grooming brush rests on the marble counter in the foreground. Photorealistic, 85mm lens, crisp focus on his confident face.
shots.motion: The man smiles confidently, radiating fresh energy. The camera slowly glides to the right, keeping his face perfectly in frame.

shots.kf: The 30-year-old man with short dark hair, a well-trimmed beard, and a black button-down shirt walks down a sunny cobblestone street in Skopje. He looks exceptionally sharp and stylish. The background features blurred historical architecture. Photorealistic, golden hour lighting, full-body tracking shot.
shots.motion: The man walks forward with a confident, steady stride. The camera tracks backward smoothly to follow his movement.

films.desc_en: A high-energy vertical social media ad featuring a luxurious splashing skincare serum.
films.music: Upbeat, trendy electronic dance beat with heavy bass, 120 bpm
vo_mk: Ослободете ја вашата природна убавина уште денес!

shots.kf: A sleek, glowing glass serum bottle hovers in mid-air over a dark marble pedestal. Dramatic spotlighting illuminates the rich amber and gold tones of the luxurious cosmetic liquid inside. Photorealistic, macro photography lens, vertical composition, highly detailed and premium aesthetic.
shots.motion: The glowing glass bottle rotates very slowly in mid-air. The camera slowly tilts up to emphasize the premium design.

shots.kf: Liquid golden serum splashes elegantly around the glowing glass bottle, frozen in a beautiful arc. Tiny droplets catch the dramatic studio light, creating a dynamic and energetic vertical composition. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high contrast with deep black and vibrant gold tones.
shots.motion: The golden liquid ripples and flows smoothly around the stationary bottle. The camera slowly pushes in on the splashing droplets.

shots.kf: A beautiful woman's face is perfectly centered in the vertical frame, showcasing incredibly glowing, flawless skin. She looks directly at the camera with a subtle, confident smile. Soft studio lighting highlights her cheekbones. Photorealistic, portrait lens, bright and clean aesthetic.
shots.motion: The woman slowly turns her face slightly towards the light, enhancing the natural glow of her skin. The camera slowly dollies backward.

films.desc_en: A single, coherent 30-second process story following one recurring hero from Skopje Old Bazaar to a simple home ritual: sourcing mineral clay, mixing the mask, applying it, rinsing, and revealing healthy glow. Same hero, same jar, consistent wardrobe and color palette; grounded, local, signage-free visuals.
films.music: Warm Balkan-acoustic minimal groove with soft frame drum and gentle guitar, 96 bpm, modern and intimate
films.voice: female, warm, grounded, Skopje accent, intimate close-mic
vo_mk: Од Старата чаршија, земам чиста глина.
Ја мешам со вода, до кремаста текстура.
По неколку минути, нежно ја испирам.

shots.kf: Skopje Old Bazaar cobblestone lane, signage-free and softly busy in the background. Our hero woman (late 20s, dark brown bob, olive skin) wears the same beige coat and black scarf. She holds one small frosted glass cosmetic jar with a matte silver lid, looking down as she scoops a pinch of pale green clay from a cloth sack into the open jar. Medium close-up, 35mm lens, natural overcast daylight, earthy greens and warm stone tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She carefully taps clay into the jar and closes the lid once. Camera makes a gentle handheld push-in and slight left-to-right drift, keeping her hands and jar centered, realistic 5-second movement.

shots.kf: Interior bathroom at home, same neutral setting for the rest of the film: off-white tiled wall, matte beige countertop, round mirror out of focus, no labels or text anywhere. The hero stands at the counter in the same beige coat now removed, revealing a simple oatmeal knit sweater, same hair and look. She opens the same frosted jar beside a clear glass bowl and pours a small stream of water from a plain tumbler into the bowl. Tight waist-level close-up, 50mm lens, soft window daylight, muted beige/green palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She pours water once and sets the tumbler down. Camera performs a slow top-down tilt to follow the water into the bowl, ending on the jar and bowl together, smooth and plausible.

shots.kf: Same bathroom counter and angle continuity. The hero’s hands mix the clay and water in the clear bowl using a simple wooden spatula; the mixture turns into a smooth pale-green cream. The frosted jar sits to frame-left, lid placed beside it, both unchanged. The hero’s face is partially visible above the bowl with a calm, focused expression, simple and natural skin texture. Close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft daylight, clean matte highlights, photorealistic and grounded.
shots.motion: She stirs in one continuous circular motion until the mixture thickens visibly. Camera makes a slow lateral slide from right to left, revealing the jar, bowl, and spatula in one connected move.

shots.kf: Same bathroom, same counter, now framed as a mirror-side close-up: the hero faces the mirror (mirror blurred, no text), applying a thin, even layer of the pale-green mask to her cheek with the wooden spatula. The frosted jar remains on the counter in the lower foreground, slightly out of focus but clearly the same object. Her hair, sweater, and lighting remain consistent. Close-up portrait, 50mm lens, soft window daylight, warm beige and muted green tones, photorealistic, natural pores, simple expression.
shots.motion: She draws one smooth stroke of mask across her cheek and lowers the spatula. Camera performs a gentle dolly-in toward her cheek, stopping before it becomes too tight, realistic 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Transform shot in the exact same bathroom, same camera angle and framing as the previous shot (matching position and lens), but after rinsing: the hero’s skin is clean and fresh with a subtle healthy glow, no mask visible. The same frosted jar sits in the same spot on the counter, lid on, unchanged. She lightly touches her cheek with fingertips, relaxed and confident. Close-up portrait, 50mm lens, same soft daylight and beige/green palette, photorealistic, natural skin detail, no glossy AI look.
shots.motion: She gently presses her fingertips to her cheek once and smiles softly. Camera holds the same position and makes a minimal, slow pull-back to reveal jar and her face together, smooth and plausible.
shots.end_kf: Same bathroom and identical framing maintained; the only change is the hero’s clean, glowing skin and the jar now closed. Countertop, tiles, light direction, wardrobe, and object placement remain consistent and signage-free, photorealistic.

films.desc_en: A clean, matched-camera transformation of one Skopje Old Bazaar salon corner—same hero stylist, same room, same angle at start and end—showing a step-by-step refresh that feels real, local, and premium without stock clichés.
films.music: Warm modern Balkan downtempo with light percussion, 92 bpm, building subtly to a bright final hit
vo_mk: Нежна нега, подготвена за секој ден.
Нов изглед, истиот наш мирис на дом.

shots.kf: Interior of a small Skopje Old Bazaar beauty salon corner, early morning. One female stylist (late 20s, dark bob hair, beige knit sweater, black apron) stands beside a tired wash station: dull off-white tiles, slightly scuffed beige cabinet, fogged mirror, tangled cords. Framing is locked-off wide from doorway height, 24mm lens. Cool daylight from one side window, muted cream and grey palette. No readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: She opens the cabinet and pulls out a folded microfiber cloth while the camera makes a slow, straight dolly-in about 40 cm, keeping the wash station centered and the frame perfectly level.
shots.end_kf: Same locked-off wide angle inside the Skopje Old Bazaar salon corner, early morning. The same stylist in identical clothes stands by the same wash station, now visibly prepped: cords coiled neatly, mirror wiped clear, counter cleared, cabinet front clean. The tiles remain the same but look brighter from cleanliness. 24mm lens, cool daylight, cream and grey palette. No readable text anywhere.

shots.kf: Close medium shot of the same wash station countertop and sink edge, hands prominent and simple. The stylist’s beige sleeve and black apron are visible as she uses a spray bottle with plain, unbranded design. Water spots, smudges and scattered cotton pads sit on the surface. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. Soft side daylight, neutral tones with a hint of warm skin color. No logos, no readable labels.
shots.motion: She sprays the surface and wipes in one continuous circular pass; the camera performs a gentle slide left-to-right about 30 cm, maintaining focus on her hands and the changing sheen of the countertop.

shots.kf: Medium shot from the same salon corner, angled slightly toward a small open shelf beside the wash station. The stylist places a plain frosted-glass pump bottle (unlabeled) onto the shelf; nearby items are mismatched and scattered. 35mm lens, natural daylight mixed with a soft practical lamp glow, creating a realistic warm-cool balance. Palette: beige, off-white, matte black apron. No readable text, no signage.
shots.motion: She aligns three identical unlabeled bottles into a straight row with one decisive adjustment; the camera makes a slow tilt down and back up, ending with the shelf perfectly centered for a clean, orderly feel.

shots.kf: Tight close-up on the stylist’s hands and a client’s forearm resting on a clean towel near the same wash station. The stylist applies a small amount of product from the same unlabeled frosted pump bottle, rubbing it gently into the skin. 85mm lens, soft daylight, flattering but realistic texture. Color palette stays calm: creams, warm skin tones, matte black. Faces are not visible, no readable text.
shots.motion: She performs one smooth application stroke from wrist to mid-forearm; the camera does a slow micro push-in, about 15 cm, emphasizing the product sheen settling naturally on skin.

shots.kf: Locked-off wide shot from the exact same doorway angle as shot 1, showing the full salon corner before the final reveal. The stylist stands still beside the wash station; the area looks partially improved but not fully finished: a towel is folded unevenly, one cord still loose, lighting still slightly flat. 24mm lens, same morning daylight, neutral cream and grey palette. No readable text or logos anywhere.
shots.motion: She snaps one towel edge into a crisp fold and gently switches on a warm practical light; the camera repeats the same slow dolly-in as shot 1, matching speed and distance for a clear before-to-after comparison.
shots.end_kf: Same locked-off wide doorway shot, identical framing and lens. The same stylist stands in the same spot, calm and proud. The wash station corner is now fully finished: mirror crystal clear, cords hidden, towels neatly stacked, shelf perfectly aligned with the same unlabeled frosted bottles, warm practical light blending with daylight for a welcoming glow. Palette remains cream, beige, matte black accents. No readable text, no signage, no logos.
